bug_info.bug_desc: In the RMA wipe sub-FSM, the word counter is loaded with BusWordsPerPage instead of 0 when moving from StRmaEraseWait to StRmaWordSel. The StRmaWordSel state then checks (word_cnt < BusWordsPerPage); since word_cnt starts at BusWordsPerPage, this condition is immediately false. As a result, the wipe sequence skips the per-word program and read-verify stages for every page and only performs page erases, so RMA entry does not randomly overwrite flash contents as required.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the load value of u_word_cnt so that word_cnt is reset to 0 when word_cnt_ld is asserted, allowing the word-selection state to start from the first word and step through the page by WidthMultiple until reaching BusWordsPerPage.
